question: After the concrete blockers and exact-head proof are resolved, should this consolidated phone-proxy Wear companion replace the staged Wear pull requests and enter the Android release train now?
rationale: This creates a first-party application and changes security and Google Play release boundaries; the linked architecture issue retains explicit maintainer, product-decision, and security-review signals that automation cannot settle.

options.title: Land the consolidated companion
options.body: Resolve the findings, prove the final head on a paired phone and watch, and use this PR as the single landing path for the approved phone-proxy design.

options.title: Split application and release wiring
options.body: Land the protocol and companion runtime first, then add Google Play form-factor enrollment, listing assets, and atomic upload in a separately reviewed release PR.

options.title: Pause first-party Wear
options.body: Keep the protocol foundation only and close the application proposals if OpenClaw does not want to own a first-party Wear release and support surface yet.

recommendation.title: Land the consolidated companion
recommendation.body: Resolve the findings, prove the final head on a paired phone and watch, and use this PR as the single landing path for the approved phone-proxy design.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the architecture direction, current-main protocol foundation, consolidated implementation, and Android release changes.
